purpose: Teach: 異色/利得/顔写真/開閉/管制/政局/ボーダー/県外

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、異色の経歴を持つ仲間と起業された
lines.en: Your father — he started the company with people who had unconventional backgrounds.
lines.style: Measured, respectful cadence. Speaking from memory, voice carrying the weight of admiration. Slight lift at the end, inviting confirmation rather than stating fact. Pause before the dash, as if choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは短期利得を求めなかった
lines.en: Yes. My father didn't chase short-term gains.
lines.style: Firm, simple affirmation. No hesitation — he's spoken these truths many times. Voice steady, almost meditative. Each word deliberate, like a stone placed in still water.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員証の顔写真も自ら確認された
lines.en: Your father — he would check the staff ID photos himself.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Slight tremor of emotion beneath the surface — tenderness for a detail most would overlook. Pause before the dash, searching for the right word. Voice carries quiet amazement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは工場扉の開閉時刻にもこだわった
lines.en: Yes. My father cared deeply about the factory door opening and closing times.
lines.style: Deliberate, almost ritualistic pacing. Voice warm but serious — explaining something that goes deeper than the words suggest. Slight emphasis on 'cared', showing this wasn't mere habit but principle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、運航管制の現場まで足を運ばれた
lines.en: Your father — he made the trip to the operations center himself.
lines.style: Gentle, admiring tone. Voice slightly lower, more intimate. The dash signals a moment of reflection — honoring the significance of that small act. Almost reverent quality, like recalling a beloved memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは政局の風を読まれた
lines.en: Yes. My father read the political winds carefully.
lines.style: Calm, knowing tone. Voice carries quiet confidence — not boastful, but assured. Speaking about foresight as if it were a natural extension of his father's character. Slight pause after 'Yes', letting the weight settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界のボーダーを越える事業を作られた
lines.en: Your father — he created a business that crossed industry lines.
lines.style: Voice lifted slightly, appreciative of ambition. Speaking with quiet admiration, as if still marveling at the scope. The dash gives space for that admiration to land. Warm, almost proud tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは県外進出を断行された
lines.en: Yes. My father boldly expanded beyond the prefecture.
lines.style: Steady, conclusive tone. This is the final statement — voice carries a sense of completion and respect. Strong but not harsh. A moment of silence implicit in the finality, honoring the decisiveness of that choice.
